timeline.message:
Unwrap exception more tenaciously in testQueuedOperationsAndBrokenRepoOnMasterFailOver

There can be more than 10 layers of wrapping RTEs, see #102351. As a
workaround to address the test failure, this commit just manually
unwraps them all.

Closes #102348
timeline.author: David Turner
